This is my take on the "Throw away the bread machine" recipe found at http://www.food.com/recipe/throw-away-the-bread-machine-instructions-white-bread-339905

I modified the recipe to make it have less holes, a more buttery flavor, richer brown sugar and fixed the salt / yeast ratios. I've made it how many times exactly as below and it comes out perfect every time! Please share your edits as well! This is just how I like doing it.

Ingredients:

1 cup warm water (110 degrees F/45degrees C)

3 tablespoons brown sugar

2 tsp instant yeast or 2.5 tsp active

4 tablespoons (1/2 stick) melted butter

2 1/2 cups white bread flour

1/2 cup of whole wheat flour

1 ½ tsp salt

Directions:

  1. Place the water into the bread pan.

  2. Sprinkle the sugar then the yeast over the water; allow the yeast to foam for 10 minutes.

  3. Add in the melted butter, flour and salt.

  4. Select the BASIC or WHITE BREAD setting (750g) and press start.
My modified version of "Throw away the bread machine recipe"
